patch_list: Restore widget editing from the search menu
Open the existing widget editor from the search bar menu when the Edit button is hidden, without changing the preference or stored widgets.

patch_list: Closes the search overlay as soon as the swipe-to-close is released, instead of after the swipe animation fully settles (removes the frozen blur when closing).
